promptTemplate: A watercolor architectural landscape of {{city}}, depicting only this journey scene: {{motif}}. Wide establishing view from across the water or an elevated viewpoint. Buildings, streets, trees, sky and local objects are the sole subjects; keep the foreground as open scenery. Paint a place, not a person or a tourist story. Tactile watercolor pigments, natural light and a clear focal point. Single complete image filling the square frame. No characters, faces, portraits, silhouettes, figures or crowds. No page layout, book, border, readable text, letters, numbers, logo or watermark.
